title: Craft workshop
text: A wonderful afternoon, great choice of projects to work which suited our party ( age 11 and adult). Fredrico is an excellent teacher. Highly recommended.
author: O6086QMcarolineb

title: A great experience
text: I am so glad we did this! It was great to take a break from the walking and looking type of activities and do something creative. The pieces we made are my favorite souvenir from the trip. Our instructor was full of knowledge and we learned a lot through conversation while working. I am so glad we did this and would definitely encourage others to do the same.
author: 185chrissyr

title: Brilliant unique heritage craft opportunity
text:
LOVED THIS ACTIVITY!!!!
Our host was an amazing man.  Patient and calming, making suggestions with no judgements.  Freddy shared knowledge and stories that interested us.

I did the painting of ceramics, learning the technique of gold leaf.  My husband (who says he’s not artistic) did the marketer, with brilliant results.
author: I6298BVmarks

title: The instructors were very...
text: The instructors were very helpful and nice, and coached each one of us with patience and great skill. The experience was one of a kind, especially as an art enthusiast.
author: Jahanavi_A

title: Excellent Experience
text: We had an excellent time at our craftwork shop! We arrived in Granada late the night before so it was our first activity in the city and it was fantastic. The host did a wonderful job walking us through the steps while also providing a history of the craft and of the city. The workshop is located in a charming shared art space and it was cool to visit a space used by locals. Would definitely recommend to people who enjoy art and making things by hand.
author: Maren_W

title: Great experience
text:
My daughter (16) and I booked the creative course with Frederic and can highly recommend it. Thanks to Frederic' s very good preparation and helpful explanations, we made some beautiful souvenirs (a chess board and a tile mosaic).
We had a lof of fun and humorous talks!
author: 364mathisz

title: Amazing time crafting our own Andalucia piece of art !
text: We had a wonderful time with Frederico !! We chose different thing to craft (see the pictures 🤩). It was delightful to discover and learn how to make Traditional Granada/Alhambra piece of art with your hand ! The place was also great (art studio) inspiring ! Frederico is a patient and lovely mentor. He took time to explain each step to guide us through the creating process. It surely suitable for children as well. It was the first time we did that kind of activity and felt lucky to do it ! We fully recommend it ! Thank you Frederico 😁
author: marielD1436MM
